summary: Paul Cohen, 56, tripped and fell on the Manitou Incline, impaling his leg on rebar and bleeding seriously; littered down Barr Trail to an ambulance and hospital.
responding_agency: El Paso County Search and Rescue
notes: Run 622 EPSO chunk. Date pin: incident occurred "soon after noon" per the contemporaneous manitouincline.com report ("today"), which links the Gazette A1 print story dated 2010-06-22 (PPLD record) — a morning paper cannot carry a noon incident same-day, so the incident was the day before, Monday 2010-06-21. KOAA/newsfirst5 video corroborates the rebar-impalement rescue. Rebar had been installed by volunteers to pin Incline ties.
